log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side
Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Altaria

decisions.rationale: Core plan: Grimm Clay screens + FO, Altaria Cloud Nine blanks sand/TW/WoW support, Mega Gengar Shadow Tag, Prim LO Liquid Voice. Leads Grimm+Altaria set up; Gengar/Prim revenge.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Opp sand (Ttar+Excadrill SoftSand), Mega Floette Fairy Aura, Gholdengo LO, Rotom-H Charcoal, Sinistcha Hospitality. Cloud Nine Altaria blanks Sand Rush/chip + TW/WoW. Mega Gengar Shadow Tag deletes Ttar/Floette/Gholdengo after Grimm Clay screens+FO. Primarina LO Liquid Voice HV/Moonblast. Bring Grimm/Altaria/Gengar/Prim. Prioritize Screen then Reflect; Mega Gengar after screens; TW enables revenge. Chople Ttar (FB not full OHKO); avoid EQ into Rotom. Sand timer independent of Ttar faint. Fairy Aura boosts our Moonblast.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo + Floette lead: Good as Gold blocks Parting Shot/Will-O-Wisp and walls Primarina; Mega Floette's boosted Fairy spam blows through Grimmsnarl/Altaria/Annihilape, and Psychic answers Mega Gengar (2x). Chople Tyranitar in back as the Gengar/Crunch check; Sinistcha's Rage Powder + Strength Sap + Fighting immunity handles Annihilape and Gliscor physical pressure while Hospitality repairs chip. Skip Excadrill (Primarina Water Hyper Voice 4x) and Rotom.

Series build/plan (durable):
My sets: Excadrill @SoftSand SandRush Adamant 205Atk/130Spe (260 in sand) HH/IronHead/RockSlide/Protect | Tyranitar @Chople SandStream 202Atk/130Def/132SpD/81Spe/HP181 RockSlide/Crunch/IceBeam/Protect | Gholdengo @LifeOrb GoodAsGold Modest 203SpA/110Spe/HP163 ShadowBall/MakeItRain/NastyPlot/Protect | Floette-Eternal @Floettite ->Mega 227SpA/142Spe/HP~149 (Fairy Aura x1.33) | Rotom-Heat @Charcoal 166SpA/122Spe | Sinistcha @Sitrus Hospitality RagePowder/MatchaGotcha/StrengthSap/ShadowBall.
Key facts: MFloette Moonblast OHKOs Altaria, 88-163% Grimmsnarl, ~26-45% Primarina thru LS; Moonblast only 0.5x vs Gengar (Poison) so use Psychic (2x) on Mega Gengar. TTar Crunch OHKOs MGengar; MGengar Focus Blast 2HKOs Chople TTar. Primarina Moonblast OHKOs TTar. Gholdengo walls Primarina (Normal immune, resists Fairy/Ice) and blocks Parting Shot/WoW; but Annihilape Rage Fist hits it 2x (CC is immune). Sinistcha immune Fighting, resists Water/Ground/Grass -> best vs Annihilape/Gliscor; note sand chips Sinistcha/Floette.
Foe habits: Grimmsnarl Prankster Light Screen T1 then Reflect T2 (Light Clay); Altaria Tailwind + Cloud Nine cancels sand; Primarina Liquid Voice Hyper Voice is WATER. Avoid Defiant boosts on Annihilape.
G2 chosen: lead Gholdengo + Floette (Mega), back Tyranitar + Sinistcha.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Altaria)
decisions.rationale: Both foes are special; Fairy Aura Mega Floette Moonblast and LO MIR threaten OHKOs without Screen. Prankster LS first, then TW for speed control. FO Gholdengo is immune; FO Floette leaves MIR free to snipe Grimm. Screens enable safe Mega Gengar later.

Prioritize Screen then Reflect; Mega Gengar after screens; TW enables revenge. Chople Ttar (FB not full OHKO); avoid EQ into Rotom. Sand timer independent of Ttar faint. Fairy Aura boosts our Moonblast. Good as Gold blocks status on Gholdengo.

decisions.rationale: Gengar resists Fairy Aura Moonblast/DG and can Mega for Shadow Tag next; Primarina takes neutral Fairy and risks LO chip. Screens up; bring Mega Gengar to pressure Gholdengo/Floette.

Grimmsnarl's Prankster Light Screen (or Fake Out on Floette) beats us regardless, so I want guaranteed chip on both foes. Mega Floette (Fairy Aura, 142 Spe, outspeeds Altaria) Moonblasts Altaria for 58-102% through screen, and Make It Rain adds 24-42% spread: Altaria is a near-certain KO this turn, removing Tailwind/Cloud Nine/Will-O-Wisp/Roost, while Grimmsnarl takes 48-90% and dies next turn. Gholdengo is immune to Fake Out and Parting Shot, so it always gets its move off.

Damage facts (no screens): MFloette Moonblast 87-153% Altaria, 88-164% Grimmsnarl (x1.33 Fairy Aura on top, halve under Light Screen); Gholdengo MakeItRain spread 96-180% Grimmsnarl, 47-84% Altaria; ShadowBall 42-76% Altaria. Moonblast only 0.5x vs Gengar (Poison) -> use Psychic (2x) on MGengar. TTar Crunch OHKOs MGengar; MGengar FocusBlast 2HKOs Chople TTar. Primarina Moonblast OHKOs TTar. Gholdengo walls Primarina and blocks PartingShot/WoW/FakeOut (Good as Gold + Normal immunity); Annihilape RageFist hits it 2x. Sinistcha immune Fighting, resists Water/Ground/Grass -> best vs Annihilape/Gliscor; sand chips Sinistcha/Floette.
Foe habits: Grimmsnarl Prankster LightScreen T1 then Reflect T2 (Light Clay), sometimes FakeOut on non-Gholdengo; Altaria Tailwind, Cloud Nine cancels sand; Primarina LiquidVoice HyperVoice is WATER. Avoid giving Annihilape Defiant boosts.
G2 plan: lead Gholdengo + Floette (Mega Floette), back Tyranitar + Sinistcha; remove Altaria then Grimmsnarl, keep Gholdengo healthy vs Primarina, save Sinistcha RagePowder for Annihilape/Gliscor.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Reflect first (Clay) completes dual screens per plan before Grimm dies. Mega Gengar Shadow Tag traps; Sludge Bomb SE OHKOes/threatens Floette through Aura while Screen cuts return Psychic/Moonblast. Gholdengo -2 less urgent.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Moonblast KOs Grimmsnarl even through Light Screen (44-82% of max vs its 24%), removing screen support. Gholdengo at -2 SpA does nothing through Light Screen and gets OHKO'd by Mega Gengar Shadow Ball (90-123%), and would be trapped by Shadow Tag next turn, so I pivot it out now to reset the drop and save it for Primarina. Tyranitar resists both Shadow Ball and Sludge Bomb (Poison 0.5x vs Rock), survives Chople'd Focus Blast (~73-99%), sets sand chip, and Crunch threatens an OHKO on Mega Gengar.

Plan: KO screen setter, keep MFloette alive as win-c

decisions.rationale: Floette fainted; I'm up 3-2. Gholdengo is my best remaining answer to Mega Gengar: fresh SpA (the -2 reset on switch), Life Orb Shadow Ball plus Tyranitar's Reflect-halved Crunch can still finish Gengar, and Gengar's Shadow Ball is not a guaranteed KO on Gholdengo at 90%. Gholdengo is also Fighting-immune (Annihilape) and walls Primarina, while Sinistcha would be sand-chipped and also fall to Shadow Ball without adding offense.

MGengar ShadowBall 63-133% Gholdengo, 68-149% Sinistcha, SludgeBomb 38-83% Sinistcha; FocusBlast 73-99% TTar with Chople (survives once, 70% acc). Primarina Moonblast OHKOs TTar; Gholdengo walls Primarina (resists Water+Fairy); Gholdengo/Sinistcha both Fighting-immune vs Annihilape, but Rage Fist is Ghost-SE on both. Gliscor EQ hits Gholdengo 2x, Sinistcha resists. Avoid stat drops on Annihilape (Defiant). Sand chips Floette/Sinistcha.
Foe habits (grok): Grimmsnarl Prankster LightScreen T1 then Reflect; Altaria Tailwind/CloudNine; Primarina LiquidVoice HyperVoice is WATER-type spread. Plan: trade screens setters early, keep a MGengar answer alive, win on numbers.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo still -2 SpA post-MIR; screens + sand up. Gengar outspeeds all: SB KO-range on 90% Gholdengo (2x Ghost). Primarina Moonblasts Ttar (2x Fairy) through Chople for heavy chip/possible KO under LO. Shadow Tag traps both; Reflect blunts Ttar Crunch/RS.

Gengar-Mega outspeeds both and its Shadow Ball is a guaranteed KO on Gholdengo at 90%, while Primarina's Moonblast (94-135%) can OHKO Tyranitar and Liquid Voice Hyper Voice (Water) does 68-97% to it. Through Light Screen/Reflect neither of my attacks KOs Gengar this turn, so attacking just trades my best pieces for chip. Double Protect (both first-use, so reliable) takes zero damage, ticks screens down a turn, and Sandstorm plus their Life Orbs chips both foes while I hold a 3-2 lead.

Damage facts (LO, sand): Gholdengo ShadowBall 99-184% MGengar, but Light Screen halves it (~49-92%) so it does NOT OHKO from full. TTar Crunch 83-161% MGengar, Reflect halves (~41-80%). MGengar ShadowBall 90-123% Gholdengo (KO at 90%), 68-149% Sinistcha; SludgeBomb 38-83% Sinistcha; FocusBlast 73-99% TTar w/ Chople (survives once, 70% acc).
CORRECTION: Primarina Liquid Voice Hyper Voice is WATER, spread: 68-97% on TTar and NEUTRAL on Gholdengo (Steel does not resist Water). Moonblast 95-135% on TTar = OHKO risk. Gholdengo resists Moonblast; Sinistcha resists Water HV.
Key rules: MGengar Shadow Tag can't trap my Ghosts (Gholdengo/Sinistcha may switch freely). Make It Rain drops own SpA 2; switching out resets it. Make It Rain is 2x on Primarina.
Plan: I'm up on numbers; MGengar can only be beaten by chipping (their LO + sand = ~16%/turn) or after Light Screen expires. TTar walls Gengar's SB/Sludge; only fear FocusBlast. Use Sinistcha RagePowder to redirect single-target Gengar attacks so Gholdengo can fire ShadowBall. Don't use consecutive Protects (33%). Kill Gengar first, then Primarina.

decisions.rationale: Both foes Protected last turn (reduced odds). Screens up tank hits. Gengar outspeeds and 2x SB pressures LO Gholdengo hard. Primarina 2x Moonblast chips Chople Ttar. Avoid FB miss and HV immunity.

Gengar outspeeds and OHKOs Gholdengo at 90% with Shadow Ball, so leaving it in likely trades my best attacker for nothing. Pivot Gholdengo to Sinistcha (bulkier vs Ghost, Sitrus, resists Primarina's Water Hyper Voice) to absorb the Shadow Ball while Tyranitar Crunches Gengar for 41-80% through Reflect. Sand plus a second Crunch or a returning Gholdengo Shadow Ball then finishes Gengar, keeping my win condition alive even if Tyranitar falls to Moonblast.

decisions.rationale: Moonblast Ttar for likely KO through Chople residual; Ttar 21% after prior SE Moonblast. Sinistcha low but Matcha threatens; screens blunt physical. Hyper Voice weak vs both. Ice Beam wastes on Ttar. Protect cedes tempo.

Primarina is their last Pokemon; I have 3 mons and only need to grind it out. Rock Slide (neutral, halved by Reflect ~18-35%) plus Matcha Gotcha (2x, halved by Light Screen ~21-37%, also heals Sinistcha) is my maximum damage output; combined with Life Orb+sand chip (~16%/turn) that can KO from 78% or leave it under ~25% for Gholdengo to clean. Rock Slide also has flinch upside. Ice Beam/Crunch are resisted; Rage Powder can't stop spread Hyper Voice.

reflections.summary: Lost because the Grimm-screens-into-Mega-Gengar preview plan was immediately dismantled by Mega Floette sniping Grimmsnarl on the setup turn, after which Ttar Crunch removed Gengar and Sinistcha+Ttar cleaned Primarina; Altaria's Cloud Nine/TW value never materialized against the brought Ttar/Gholdengo/Sinistcha/Mega-Floette.
reflections.adjustment: Question the bring/mega: vs this core delay or skip early Mega Gengar and lead Altaria (Cloud Nine+TW) or pressure Floette first so Grimm can set both screens safely before tagging.
reflections.notebook: Matchup: Opp sand (Ttar+Excadrill SoftSand), Mega Floette Fairy Aura, Gholdengo LO, Rotom-H Charcoal, Sinistcha Hospitality. Cloud Nine Altaria blanks Sand Rush/chip + TW/WoW. Mega Gengar Shadow Tag deletes Ttar/Floette/Gholdengo after Grimm Clay screens+FO. Primarina LO Liquid Voice HV/Moonblast. Chople Ttar (FB not full OHKO); avoid EQ into Rotom. Sand timer independent of Ttar faint. Fairy Aura boosts our Moonblast. Good as Gold blocks status on Gholdengo. Revealed game2 bring Ttar/Gholdengo/Sinistcha/Mega Floette (no Exca/Rotom); Ttar Adamant RockSlide/Crunch/IceBeam/Protect; Floette Modest Moonblast/DazzlingGleam/Psychic/Protect; Gholdengo Modest ShadowBall/MakeItRain/NastyPlot/Protect; Sinistcha Calm RagePowder/MatchaGotcha/StrengthSap/ShadowBall Sitrus. Opp dual-Protect on prediction; Floette punishes Grimm hard. Future: lead Altaria or remove Floette before Grimm screens; Mega Gengar only on isolated targets.

reflections.summary: Won because the opponent's support structure collapsed immediately: Grimmsnarl went down to Moonblast on turn 2 before Light Screen mattered much, and Tyranitar's Crunch removed Mega Gengar on turn 4, leaving only Life Orb Primarina to be ground down by sand + Life Orb recoil while Sinistcha healed through with Matcha Gotcha/Hospitality. The preview plan was only half-right: Mega Floette traded itself for Grimmsnarl (fine value) but was a liability into Gengar's Sludge Bomb and died on the turn
reflections.adjustment: Bring Excadrill over Floette-Eternal and decline the Mega entirely against this team (or hold Floettite for a game where Gengar/Sludge Bomb isn't in the four). Excadrill under self-made sand outspeeds their whole side, resists Fairy so it isn't Moonblast-fodder like Tyranitar, and hits Mega Gengar (no Levitate) and Grimmsnarl hard. Core: Tyranitar + Excadrill + Gholdengo + Sinistcha, with Gholdengo brought in early and actively against Primarina — it is immune to sand, resists Fairy, and Primari
